mina: posting a short summary from the newest bring-up: orion-v2 int8 showed weird splits when U+2009 (thin space) appears between CJK and latin. small but reproducible BLEU drop on ja->en samples (~0.6).

cheng: reproduced locally. interestingly FP16 and int8 tokenization are identical pre-infer. here's a tiny repro showing generation output differences.

```
# repro snippet
echo -n "\u65e5\u672c\u2009hello" | ./infer --model orion-v2 --quant int8 --input -
# output-int8: \u65e5\u672chello
# output-fp16: \u65e5\u672c\u2009hello
```

yuki: i inspected the postprocess logs on the canary. The serving runtime serializes token stream to the `postproc` queue and a small sidecar `detok-lite` performs whitespace normalization. That lite binary is built from an older branch with `collapse_thin_space=true`.

sanjay: does detok-lite run for fp16 too?

cheng: fp16 canary was using a newer pod image (main) that enabled preservation. The int8 canary referenced an earlier manifest pinned to `detok-lite:2024-09-compat`.

mina: given the pattern (nbspace, narrow no-break earlier), this is becoming a recurring class of issues where whitespace-sensitive Unicode chars are mangled by pinned postprocess images during quant bring-ups.

yuki: agreed. immediate steps: (1) update int8 canary manifests to use `detok-lite:main` while we patch the compatibility branch; (2) add unit tests for U+2009 in detok-lite and mark them as required in the CI for any detok image build; (3) add thinspace/nbspace/zwsp cases to the multilingual dev bundle.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] detok-lite PR #22 started  running unit tests

cheng: quick local hack bypassing detok-lite (join tokens naïvely) returns BLEU to baseline. so root cause clearly postprocess.

sanjay: longer term: we should add a preflight assertion in the quant onboarding pipeline that verifies the postprocess image tag is >= main commit or contains a whitelist of flags (preserve_thinspace=true). Prevents regressions from pinned images.

mina: added a TODO in the onboard doc and opened infra issue #1207 to add the manifest lint. I'll follow up with a short note in the bring-up checklist.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] detok-lite PR #22 passed  8 tests :white_check_mark:

mina: thanks all. marking resolved for now. we'll expand the locale smoke matrix to include thin/nb/zwsp. if anyone see other odd whitespace chars (e.g., FIGURE SPACE) ping this thread. :sparkles:
